search_text: published ZDI-15-149 ZDI-CAN-2579 Novell Zenworks Rtrlet.class Session ID Disclosure Vulnerability 2015-04-22 CVE-2015-0784 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-0784 6.8 ['Novell'] ['Zenworks'] This vulnerability allows attackers to disclose Session ID's of logged in users on vulnerable installations of Novell Zenworks. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within Rtrlet.class. By sending a POST request with the maintenance variable set to "ShowLogins" the applet returns information about the logged in users. title: Novell Zenworks Rtrlet.class Session ID Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to disclose Session ID's of logged in users on vulnerable installations of Novell Zenworks. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within Rtrlet.class. By sending a POST request with the maintenance variable set to "ShowLogins" the applet returns information about the logged in users. An attacker can leverage this to leak the Session ID's of the logged in users.
